in_sanskrit.name: Jameer
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ocean of Peace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jameer एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Someone who is an embodiment of tranquility, calmness and peace, like the deep, unruffled waters of the ocean.

in_tamil.name: Jameer
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Ocean of Peace
in_tamil.long_meaning: Jameer ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Someone who is an embodiment of tranquility, calmness and peace, like the deep, unruffled waters of the ocean.

in_telugu.name: Jameer
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Ocean of Peace
in_telugu.long_meaning: Jameer ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Someone who is an embodiment of tranquility, calmness and peace, like the deep, unruffled waters of the ocean.

in_marathi.name: Jameer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ocean of Peace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jameer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Someone who is an embodiment of tranquility, calmness and peace, like the deep, unruffled waters of the ocean.

in_bengali.name: Jameer
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Ocean of Peace
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jameer একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Someone who is an embodiment of tranquility, calmness and peace, like the deep, unruffled waters of the ocean.
